# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rsync --exclude-from list for the monorepo mirror.
#
# IMPORTANT: rsync evaluates rules top-to-bottom and the FIRST match wins.
# Every "+ " (include) rule must therefore appear ABOVE the "- " (exclude)
# rule that would otherwise swallow it. Do not reorder this file casually.
#
# Rule of thumb: mirror source, docs, configs and tests. Never mirror data,
# weights, caches, or CI plumbing that belongs to the component repo only.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ===========================================================================
# 1. EXPLICIT INCLUDES (must come first)
# ===========================================================================
+ tests/
+ tests/fixtures/
+ tests/fixtures/**
+ configs/
+ configs/**
+ .env.example
+ __huggingface_repos__.json

# ===========================================================================
# 2. Git / CI plumbing - belongs to tcwpn_test only
# ===========================================================================
- .git/
- .github/
- .gitattributes

# ===========================================================================
# 3. Clinical / restricted data (PhysioNet DUA, NHSL notes)
#    R26-DS-012 is PUBLIC. None of this may ever leave this repository.
# ===========================================================================
- data/
- mimic*/
- nhsl*/
- *.csv
- *.tsv
- *.parquet
- *.feather
- *.jsonl
- *.db
- *.sqlite
- *.sqlite3

# ===========================================================================
# 4. Model artefacts - use HF Hub / DVC, not git
# ===========================================================================
- *.pt
- *.pth
- *.bin
- *.ckpt
- *.h5
- *.pkl
- *.safetensors
- checkpoints/
- outputs/
- runs/
- wandb/
- mlruns/
- lightning_logs/

# ===========================================================================
# 5. Secrets
# ===========================================================================
- .env
- .env.*
- *.pem
- *.key
- credentials*

# ===========================================================================
# 6. Caches and local noise
# ===========================================================================
- __pycache__/
- *.py[cod]
- .pytest_cache/
- .ruff_cache/
- .mypy_cache/
- .ipynb_checkpoints/
- .venv/
- venv/
- env/
- .DS_Store
- Thumbs.db
- *.log
- .coverage
- coverage.xml
- htmlcov/
- dist/
- build/
- *.egg-info/
- .idea/
- .vscode/
